Hi! I'm Rainbow, your AI assistant here at Pelangi Hostel 🌈. We have limited on-site parking, so it's best to contact us in advance for a guaranteed spot. There's also off-site public street parking nearby for RM0.60/hour during working hours, and it's free outside those hours, on Sundays, and public holidays.
